goal: Build a reusable serializable Workspace Engine and integrate a three-module demo into ALINA Control Center.
why: Move FATHER from fixed pages toward task-oriented compositions while testing improved ALINA context delivery after Experiment 001.
constraints: Workspace state must not contain domain payloads
Persist stable panel/content IDs, not React nodes or functions
Shared engine must not import ALINA application code
State transitions must be deterministic and unit-tested
Responsive transforms must preserve panel identity
Keyboard focus and reduced-motion requirements remain active
project_decisions: Screen is a composition of modules, not a monolithic page
Shared engines remain reusable beyond ALINA
acceptance_criteria: ALINA demo renders at least three workspace modules from state
test_contract: Workspace engine unit tests cover core transitions
App tests verify three module identities
open_questions: Should persisted layout storage use localStorage first or remain pure core until M0.3 acceptance?
